title: Linear App Style
content: Apply Linear aesthetic with project management feel. Minimal chrome with maximum content. Ultra-fast keyboard shortcuts. Real-time collaboration indicators. Status workflows (backlog, todo, in progress, done). Cycles and projects. Priority levels. Label management. Roadmap views. Integrations display. Activity feeds.

variants.simple: Create issue tracker with clean minimal design, fast keyboard navigation, and real-time sync.
variants.detailed: Apply Linear aesthetic with project management feel. Minimal chrome with maximum content. Ultra-fast keyboard shortcuts. Real-time collaboration indicators. Status workflows (backlog, todo, in progress, done). Cycles and projects. Priority levels. Label management. Roadmap views. Integrations display. Activity feeds.
variants.advanced: Apply Linear aesthetic with issue tracking patterns. Colors: white/light bg with purple accent (#5E6AD2), dark mode with purple highlights. Typography: Inter font, minimal sizes, tight spacing. Navigation: compact sidebar, icons + labels, collapse to icons only. Issue list: priority indicator, ID, title, status pill, assignee avatar, labels. Issue detail: full screen, markdown description, activity sidebar. Status workflow: columns (Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done), drag between. Priority: urgent (red), high (orange), medium (yellow), low (gray), no priority (empty). Keyboard: heavy keyboard use, hints in tooltips, command palette Cmd+K. Real-time: presence indicators, cursor positions, typing indicators. Projects: group issues, progress bar, target date. Cycles: time-boxed sprints, velocity tracking. Roadmap: timeline view, milestone markers. Labels: colored pills, manageable. Filters: compound filters, save views. Search: instant, fuzzy matching. Inbox: notifications with mark read. Integrations: GitHub, Figma, Slack icons and links. Views: list, board, timeline switch. Comments: threaded, reactions, @mentions. Attachments: inline images, file links. Archive: completed cycles, closed issues.

author: Ersin KOÇ
